description: This file defines the 'Download' model class for the OpenCart admin system, handling CRUD operations and data management related to downloadable files in the catalog. It interacts with the database to add, edit, delete, and retrieve download records, descriptions, and report data.

classes.name: Download
classes.description: A model class managing downloadable file records within the OpenCart admin catalog module, providing methods for CRUD operations and related data handling.

methods.name: addDownload
methods.description: Inserts a new download record into the database, including descriptions for multiple languages, and returns the new download ID.

methods.name: editDownload
methods.description: Updates an existing download record and its descriptions based on provided data.

methods.name: deleteDownload
methods.description: Removes a download record and its related descriptions, reports, and associated product links.

methods.name: getDownload
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific download record by ID.

methods.name: getDownloads
methods.description: Fetches a list of download records with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalDownloads
methods.description: Returns the total count of download records, optionally filtered by criteria.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Creates a new description entry for a specific download in a specified language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all description entries associated with a specific download ID.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all description entries associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a particular download ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all description entries for a specified language.

methods.name: getReports
methods.description: Retrieves download report records (such as access logs) for a specific download ID with optional pagination.

methods.name: deleteReports
methods.description: Deletes all report entries related to a specific download ID.

methods.name: getTotalReports
methods.description: Returns the total count of report entries for a given download ID.
